user.description: KEMS will scan Home Assistant for compatible Octopus Energy, Ohme, and FoxESS Modbus entities.
user.title: Set up KEMS

data_description.review_entities: Open the full mapping screen before KEMS is created.

confirm.title: Set up KEMS automatically

data_description.battery_current: FoxESS Modbus Battery Current sensor, used with Battery Voltage to derive battery power.
data_description.battery_power_kw: Optional direct battery power sensor. If absent, KEMS derives power from FoxESS voltage and current.
data_description.battery_soc: FoxESS Modbus battery state of charge percentage.
data_description.battery_voltage: FoxESS Modbus Battery Voltage sensor, used with Battery Current to derive battery power.
data_description.ev_charging: Optional legacy/custom Ohme binary sensor; the Ohme status sensor is preferred.
data_description.ev_connected: Optional legacy/custom Ohme binary sensor; the Ohme status sensor is preferred.
data_description.ev_soc: Ohme vehicle state of charge percentage.
data_description.ev_status: Ohme charger status sensor; KEMS derives connected and charging states from it.
data_description.grid_export_kw: FoxESS Modbus power currently exported to the grid.
data_description.grid_import_kw: FoxESS Modbus power currently imported from the grid.
data_description.house_load_kw: FoxESS Modbus total house load power.
data_description.intelligent_slot: Octopus binary sensor for an active Intelligent dispatch slot.
data_description.next_offpeak_start: Octopus timestamp for the next cheap period start.
data_description.off_peak: Octopus binary sensor that is on during off-peak periods.
data_description.offpeak_end: Octopus timestamp for the current or next cheap period end.

entities.description: Choose the entities KEMS observes. Only the current import rate is required; Ohme and FoxESS Modbus can be added later through Reconfigure.
entities.title: Review KEMS source entities

reconfigure.description: KEMS has rescanned Home Assistant. Review the mappings below, including any newly installed Ohme or FoxESS Modbus entities.
reconfigure.title: Rescan and reconfigure KEMS

data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Defaults to Kyle's planned 56.42 kWh FoxESS battery stack and can be changed.
data_description.battery_initial_percent: Used when no real FoxESS battery SOC is available.
data_description.battery_reserve_percent: The simulation will not discharge below this level.
data_description.charge_efficiency: Fraction of imported charging energy retained in the battery.
data_description.discharge_efficiency: Fraction of stored energy delivered to the home.
data_description.export_rate_pence: Used only when no live Octopus export-rate entity is detected.
data_description.history_days: KEMS stores compact observations locally in Home Assistant storage.
data_description.max_charge_kw: Defaults to the planned FoxESS KH10 power limit.
data_description.max_discharge_kw: Defaults to the planned FoxESS KH10 power limit.
data_description.scan_interval_seconds: KEMS reads Home Assistant state only; minimum 30 seconds.
data_description.simulation_strategy: Export first follows Kyle's tariff-arbitrage plan; self-use supplies the house from solar first.

init.description: These settings affect only KEMS analysis and simulation. KEMS never writes to Octopus, Ohme, or FoxESS Modbus in this version.
init.title: KEMS learning and simulation settings
